name: hyperbuild
description: Turns Claude Code into an app factory: one idea prompt in, a researched, designed, planned, and implemented application out, with exactly two human touchpoints. /hyperbuild <idea> runs a 14-step autonomous Stage A — market recon, social sentiment mining, a research audit, PRD and feature specs, stack research, three complete design systems with HTML mockups of every screen, project-specific skill generation, and epics/tasks — then stops at a design gate. /hyperbuild-choose a|b|c runs Stage B: scaffold, wave-parallel implementation with git discipline, adversarial review, and a traceability ship gate that ends in a working app.
